attempt_accounting.capture_boundary: Immediately after provider response receipt and before action parsing/cost parsing.

failure_policy.agent_parse_failure: Valid provider usage counts before parsing; normal identical agent retry path applies; all attempts retained.
failure_policy.api_retry: Internal retry only; every generated/provider attempt is retained and counted when usage is valid.
failure_policy.benchmark_environment_failure: Preserve as INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID with evidence; no task replacement. No automatic condition-specific exclusion or rerun.
failure_policy.harness_crash: Preserve crash and all provider attempts. No automatic whole-run retry. If accounting is incomplete, TOKEN_ACCOUNTING_INVALID.
failure_policy.provider_timeout: Use identical frozen provider retry policy. Every attempt with provider usage counts. If usage is unrecoverable for a possibly billed attempt, mark UNKNOWN/TOKEN_ACCOUNTING_INVALID.
failure_policy.task_timeout: Task failure; preserve and count all valid provider usage; no automatic whole-run retry.

accounting_and_invalidation.paired_invalid_policy: If any A/B/C/D run for a frozen task has unrecoverable TOKEN_ACCOUNTING_INVALID or a pre-provider independently verified infrastructure invalidation, exclude that task from the paired cross-condition primary comparison for ALL four conditions; preserve and report every raw task-condition outcome and invalidity. Never treat invalid usage as zero and never silently drop it.
accounting_and_invalidation.resolution_rate_denominator: All 12 frozen task attempts per condition. Accounting invalidity does not erase evaluator outcome from the reported resolution-rate audit.
accounting_and_invalidation.success_source: Pinned Terminal-Bench deterministic task verifier/scorer at the same benchmark revision; never agent self-report.
accounting_and_invalidation.unknown_rule: Missing, malformed, internally inconsistent, or unrecoverable provider usage => UNKNOWN and task-condition TOKEN_ACCOUNTING_INVALID.

benchmark.replacement_policy: NO_RETROSPECTIVE_TASK_REPLACEMENT. A genuine infrastructure defect is preserved in provenance; changing the subset requires an Orchestrator decision and a new experiment version before affected comparative results are interpreted.
benchmark.success_evaluator: Pinned Terminal-Bench deterministic task verifier/scorer from the same benchmark revision.
benchmark.task_selection: task.toml metadata only; no solution/reference-answer inspection; no agent/model outcomes

A.name: FULL_NATIVE_HISTORY
A.provider_context: system + original task + complete pristine/native conversation history

B.name: LAST_4
B.provider_context: system + original task + last 4 COMPLETE native assistant/tool-observation steps verbatim; incomplete trailing step excluded

C.name: STRUCTURED_MEMORY
C.provider_context: system + original task + optional HISTORICAL_MEMORY_DATA_V1 user message + last 4 complete native steps verbatim

D.name: LEXICAL_ONLY
D.provider_context: same framing and Last-4 treatment as C

conditions.difference_rule: Only frozen history/memory treatment may differ. C and D share storage, chunks, write policy, eligibility, safety/freshness, dedup/conflict handling, budget, source-step limits, framing and serialization; D differs from C only in ranking/selection policy.

execution.schedule_strategy: Deterministic four-condition cyclic Latin-square schedule repeated three times over the fixed 12-task order.

hash_definition: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 bytes of manifests/experiment_manifest.final.json, canonical JSON sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=true plus one trailing LF.

memory.lexical_only_policy: Pure primary FTS5/BM25 reciprocal-rank signal; candidates with zero lexical score, including nonlexical supplemental-only candidates, are ineligible for D selection.
memory.local_packing_estimator: canonical UTF-8 byte = 1 local packing unit; never scientific provider-token metric

primary_thresholds.likely_stop_or_simplify: less than 10% gain, meaningful solve-rate loss, or Last-4 closely matches structured memory
primary_thresholds.strong: at least 30% lower with equal or higher solve rate
primary_thresholds.worthwhile: at least 20% lower with no meaningful solve-rate loss

provenance.independent_chat4_review: Source/diff audit plus independent raw-artifact/JUnit/T10 evidence recomputation; no Terminal-Bench task execution.

performance_reservation.note: Do not clear; retrieval-induced runtime/timeout is a real condition outcome, not an accounting exclusion.

provider.api_base_binding: TOKENROUTER_BASE_URL remains external runtime configuration; exact URL is not committed. Its exact pre-execution SHA-256 is frozen in provider.api_base_expected_sha256 and must match before every provider invocation.
provider.api_base_hash_canonicalization: SHA-256 over exact TOKENROUTER_BASE_URL environment string encoded as UTF-8; no trimming or normalization.
provider.api_base_preflight_rule: Before every benchmark provider invocation, compute SHA-256 over exact runtime TOKENROUTER_BASE_URL UTF-8 bytes and require equality with provider.api_base_expected_sha256. Mismatch => CONFIGURATION_INVALID and ABORT_BEFORE_PROVIDER_CALL. API key remains secret and MUST NOT be hashed into public artifacts.

scientific_question: Does structured memory reduce provider-reported tokens per successful task without sacrificing task success?

task_environment_identity_freeze.method: Pinned Terminal-Bench task.toml blob + complete environment Git tree + Docker/container-definition blobs + registry-resolved external base-image manifest digests for linux/amd64. No solution/reference-answer files read; no agent/provider calls.
task_environment_identity_freeze.resulting_image_digest_policy: Primary expected identity is the immutable composite packet because deterministic byte-identical rebuilds were not established for all network/package-manager-based task images. Before provider invocation, the runtime-built image digest is additionally mandatory and must be identical across A/B/C/D for the same task.
task_environment_identity_freeze.runtime_preflight_rule: Before any provider call, verify pinned Terminal-Bench revision, task.toml blob, complete environment Git tree, every container-definition blob SHA and SHA-256, and every external base image registry/platform digest against this packet. Any mismatch => CONFIGURATION_INVALID/INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID and ABORT_BEFORE_PROVIDER_CALL. Never silently rebuild from a changed moving tag after comparative execution begins. For a task, the runtime-built image digest must additionally be recorded and must be identical across A/B/C/D before provider invocation.
